description: Get per-condition if/else and show/hide performance stats for conditional blocks inside an email (campaign, sequence email or A/B step, or transactional email), or a sequence-wide conditional health overview when sourceType is 'sequence'. Returns collapsed conditionGroups (grouping sibling blocks with identical rules), email baseline averages, percentage-point deltas vs email average, topClickedLink per branch, dead-rule/fallback alerts, raw blocks[], and coverage metadata. For sequence_step, pass both sequenceId and sourceId (the step nodeId); for sequence, pass sourceId as the sequenceId.

abTestVariantId.description: Optional A/B test variant ID to filter campaign or sequence A/B step sends.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

end.description: ISO 8601 end of send window; send start too.

goalId.description: Optional goal ID (or 'default-revenue') to filter attributed conversions and trackedValue. Omit for deduplicated conversions across all goals.

includeMachineEngagement.description: Include machine/privacy-proxy opens and clicks (default false).

period.description: Time period: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, or all. Defaults to all for campaigns and 30d for sequence steps and transactional emails.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID. Required when sourceType is 'sequence_step'.

sourceId.description: Campaign ID, sequence ID (when sourceType is 'sequence'), sequence email step nodeId (when sourceType is 'sequence_step'), or transactional email ID or slug.

sourceType.description: Email source type: 'campaign', 'sequence' (sequence-wide overview across all email steps), 'sequence_step', or 'transactional'.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of send window; send end too.

name: get_conditional_block_stats

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_conditional_block_stats` MCP tool.

abTestVariantId.description: Filtered A/B test variant ID, or null.

alertCount.description: Total conditional rule alerts across the sequence (when sourceType is 'sequence').

alerts.description: Automatic rule-health alerts (never_matched, empty_state_spike, lopsided_else, fail_closed_spike).

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

baseline.description: Recorded-send email baseline averages (sends, deliveries, openRate, clickRate, conversionRate, unsubscribeRate, bounceRate), or null.

blocks.description: Per-block conditional metrics: blockId, kind, label, conditionSummary, inEmail, tracked, insideRepeat, evaluatedSends, skippedSends, notInVersionSends, and branches[] with sends, share, deliveries, opens, openRate, openRateDeltaPts, clicks, clickRate, clickRateDeltaPts, unsubscribes, bounces, complaints, conversions, conversionRate, conversionRateDeltaPts, trackedValue, topClickedLink.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

conditionGroups.description: Collapsed rule groups merging sibling blocks with identical conditions, including blockCount, representativeBlockId, ctaLabel, snippetLines, previewVersionIndex, alerts, and branches[] with rate deltas vs baseline and topClickedLink.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

failClosedSends.description: Sends where subscriber rules could not be checked and fell back to Otherwise.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

recordedSends.description: Sends that recorded conditional block branch decisions.

steps.description: Per-step conditional summaries and alerts (when sourceType is 'sequence').

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

stepsWithConditions.description: Number of email steps in the sequence with conditional blocks (when sourceType is 'sequence').

timedOut.description: True when the ClickHouse query timed out; retry with a shorter period.

totalRuleGroups.description: Total collapsed conditional rule groups across the sequence (when sourceType is 'sequence').

totalSends.description: Total non-test sends in the window.

trackingSince.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the earliest recorded send in the window, or null.

truncatedSends.description: Sends that exceeded the 50 conditional block recording limit.

untrackedSends.description: Sends in the window that predate conditional block tracking.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
